title: Scientific Research Lifecycle Full
description: Full Solar-native scientific research lifecycle represented as explicit TaskGraph nodes.

nodes.goal: Import user-supplied evidence through an execution-produced hash and provenance receipt.
acceptance: Every imported artifact is non-empty and hash verified.
The import produces new provenance evidence rather than accepting scientific claims directly.

nodes.goal: Discover candidate literature and produce bounded shortlist evidence.
acceptance: Emits or validates literature_discovery.v1 evidence for ScientificLiteratureDiscoverer.
Records failed or inconclusive status instead of inventing missing evidence.
Does not call a hidden backend full workflow runner.
pass_conditions: literature_discovery.v1 payload is present or the node records failed/inconclusive evidence with limitations.
Source evidence ids and provenance are preserved where applicable.

nodes.goal: Evaluate the produced publication and its execution evidence before Solar accepts the research lifecycle.
acceptance: Evaluates the publication produced by the lifecycle rather than pre-supplied evidence.
Requires a non-empty report, source evidence, artifact hashes, and an accepted independent review.
Does not mutate Solar graph or final state.
pass_conditions: research_final_evaluation.v1 records accepted only when the produced report and evidence satisfy all checks.
Any failed check is retained with a concrete reason.

manual_review_checklist: Every node has logical_operator, required_capabilities, read_scope, write_scope, gate, and acceptance.
No node calls a full backend black-box workflow.
Experiment-running nodes require bounded mode or human approval.

completed_node_detection: typed evidence artifact exists and matches node.evidence_policy.expected_schema

lifecycle_artifacts.node_result_contract: Each node writes a typed evidence artifact and appends one evidence.jsonl entry.
